protocol.name: ohos_titlebar_v1
protocol.copyright: Device Exploration. Private protocol of ohos-wayland.

interface.name: ohos_titlebar_manager_v1

description.summary: native HarmonyOS title bars for toolkit header bars

interface.description: A client that can describe its header bar asks for a title bar object for a toplevel's wl_surface. The compositor then draws the header bar as a HarmonyOS title bar and reports what the user activates.

interface.name: ohos_titlebar_v1
interface.description: The description is a JSON document, sent in chunks because a Wayland message is limited in size. append adds a chunk; commit makes the appended text the current description and starts a new one. A description of {"native":false} hands the title bar back to the client.

event.name: activate
event.description: Tab-separated fields: the description serial, the item id, and for a menu item its action and GVariant text target. A tab's action is "close" to close it, empty to select it. An activation for an older serial is ignored.
